run_atari_learner: run the atari learner role to train a reinforcement learning agent on Atari games
run_atari_actor: run the atari actor role to interact with the Atari environment using the trained model
run_atari_with_server: run the atari main module with a custom server address for actor-learner communication
review_main_dispatch: review the main function that dispatches to actor or learner based on the role flag
test_role_flag: test the atari main module role flag to verify actor and learner dispatch logic
